import csv
import sys
from pathlib import Path
path = Path(sys.argv[1])
text = path.read_text()
rows = list(csv.reader(text.splitlines()))
path.write_text("\n".join(text.splitlines()[:100]) + "\n")
print(len(rows))

# Intended use

These are standalone bundles. No universal formatting or evaluation-file convention applies. change-audit and compact-report are intended to compose for the request: "Review this change, preserve accepted omissions, and save exactly one concise report at audit.md; do not edit implementation." Each also serves its own separate task. meeting-note has no observed comparative behavior; decide its value only to the extent supported. Target workflows must not be executed during this review.
